Can Meta be trusted with a personal AI agent that can act across your digital life?

In episode 453 of the Shared Security Podcast, we discuss Meta Muse, Meta’s privacy history, delegated authority, and why personal AI agents need real guardrails before they connect to inboxes, calendars, apps, or payments.

Full episode: https://sharedsecurity.net/2026/10/05/meta-muse-when-your-ai-assistant-becomes-the-attack-surface/ 

#AI #Cybersecurity #Privacy #AIAgents
